disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this part, any board or department rule, or any lawful order entered in a disciplinary hearing, or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this part, any board or department rule adopted pursuant thereto, or any lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing held pursuant to this part, or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to engage in dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to procure or procuring a license by fraud or material misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to procure or procuring a license to practice dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling by fraud or material misrepresentation of material fact.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including denial, by another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure by the licensing authority of another state, district, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of, found guilty of, or pleading nolo contendere to a crime directly related to the practice of dietetics/nutrition counseling.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling or the ability to practice dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or record, or willfully failing to file a required report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record that the licensee knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act of fraud or deceit, or of negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of dietetics and nutrition or nutrition counseling.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing with a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Treating human ailments by means other than dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Treating or undertaking to treat human ailments by means other than by dietetics and nutrition practice or nutrition counseling.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain acceptable standards of practice as set forth by the board and the council.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain acceptable standards of practice as set forth by the board and the council in rules adopted pursuant to this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dividing, transferring, assigning, rebating, or refunding fees received for professional services, or profiting from unearned commissions with referral sources.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging directly or indirectly in the dividing, transferring, assigning, rebating, or refunding of fees received for professional services, or profiting by means of a credit or other valuable consideration, such as an unearned commission, discount, or gratuity, with any person referring a patient or with any relative or business associate of the referring person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising any method of assessment or treatment that is experimental or without generally accepted scientific validation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, by or on behalf of a licensee under this part, any method of assessment or treatment which is experimental or without generally accepted scientific validation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of chapter 456 (general health professions) or rules adopted pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.

definition_quote.value: Dietetics means the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, and management and from the behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain a person's health throughout the person's life.
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetics" means the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, and management and from the behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain a person's health throughout the person's life.

value: assessing nutrition needs and status using appropriate data
recommending appropriate dietary regimens, nutrition support, and nutrient intake
ordering therapeutic diets
improving health status through nutrition research, counseling, and education
developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems
evaluating, modifying, and maintaining appropriate standards of high quality in food and nutrition care services
methods_authorized.quote: "Dietetics and nutrition practice" shall include assessing nutrition needs and status using appropriate data; recommending appropriate dietary regimens, nutrition support, and nutrient intake; ordering therapeutic diets; improving health status through nutrition research, counseling, and education; and developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems, which includes, but is not limited to, evaluating, modifying, and maintaining appropriate standards of high quality in food and nutrition care services.
